query: Has the built-up area increased, decreased, or remained unchanged between these dates?

findings.headline: Built-up area increased in the eastern section (+25.2% expansion), mainly around the new road corridor and adjacent settlements.
key_observations: Built-up Infrastructure: Substantial structural additions (+25.2% / 25.2 km²) concentrated along the eastern transport artery.
Surface Dynamics: Total detected land-cover transition is 29.0% (29.0 km²) across the 100 km² observation footprint.
Hydrology & River: The main drainage waterway and riparian embankments maintained strict morphological stability.
Southern Transition: Peripheral bare land parcels in the south transitioned from fallow ground into active construction sites.
